description: Binds the stacking combat perks (Bullet Storm, Onslaught and similar) to the converted perks and mods.
x-help:
These perks build stacks while you shoot. Tales knows each by a fixed name (slug); this catalog says which perk or weapon mod each name is. You rarely edit it by hand.

'Cards' binds perk cards; 'Items' binds weapon mods and a few perks. Leave 'Maximum stacks' alone unless you are balancing a mod.
